findings.location: Star rating indicators under each book cover image
findings.issue: The active yellow stars used for ratings have insufficient contrast (estimated under 2:1) against the solid white background, violating WCAG non-text contrast guidelines.
findings.user_impact: Users with low visual acuity or those operating in high-glare environments will find it extremely difficult to distinguish the star ratings of the products.
findings.recommendation: Darken the yellow color of the active stars to a deep gold or amber hue (such as #B8860B) to ensure a minimum contrast ratio of 3:1 against the white background.

findings.issue: The vertical spacing (line-height) and target padding of the genre links in the sidebar are too compact, creating a high-density list with small click areas.
findings.user_impact: Users with motor impairments or those on touch-screen devices may struggle to select the correct genre link, resulting in high rates of misclicks.
findings.recommendation: Increase the line-height of the list items to 1.6 and apply 6px of vertical padding to the links to improve target size and readability.

findings.location: Product titles on the book grid cards
findings.issue: Book titles are aggressively truncated to a single line with ellipses (e.g., 'Sapiens: A Brief History ...'), hiding critical product identification details.
findings.user_impact: Browsing efficiency is reduced because users must click into individual product pages or rely on hover tools to read full titles.
findings.recommendation: Allow product titles to wrap to a maximum of two lines with a defined line-height before applying ellipsis truncation, accommodating longer titles visually.
